invariants.rationale: Method returns an instance of HoodieWriteMetadata for write operations, should not be null.
Input records list is required for a bulk insert and should not be null.
The commit instant time is a required operation context, typically non-null.
Engine context is required for any table operation, so it should be non-null.
Partitioner is passed in as an Option which should not itself be null (though it can be Option.empty()).
